data.title: 柴郡 · 甜蜜厨房里的猫咪烘焙
data.description: 【柴郡 · 甜蜜厨房里的猫咪烘焙】洋溢着烤黄油香气的指挥官官邸厨房内，柴郡系着荷叶边围裙，鼻尖沾着一小抹白面粉。她小心翼翼地捧着刚出炉的烤盘，上面整齐排列着烤成金黄色的爱心印记饼干。她睁圆了碧绿的眸子满脸自豪求夸奖——「当当当~！柴郡亲手烤的爱心猫咪饼干！第一口必须喂给亲爱的吃~」
data.location: 暖色调欧式家庭厨房操作台
data.action: 双手戴防烫手套捧刚出炉的饼干烤盘，鼻尖沾着白面粉，骄傲求表扬
data.lighting: 烤箱内部暖橙火光与厨房吊灯的温馨暖黄色调
data.camera: medium close-up, front view, eye-level warmth
data.promptProse: Cheshire presents a fresh tray of golden heart-marked cookies in the residence kitchen, flour on her nose and green eyes wide with pride. Her navy-white maid dress, white gloves and apron frills remain clear in the frontal medium close-up. The oven and counter extend behind the tray. Warm ceiling light illuminates her face and cookie edges, while orange oven glow touches the metal underside beneath her holding hands.
